items.risk: Large contracted commitments require substantial timely capacity buildout and create customer concentration/execution exposure.
Rapid infrastructure scaling remains capital intensive and leverage increases fixed obligations.
Power, GPU supply, construction and commissioning become successor bottlenecks after demand is contracted.
Customer concentration and buildout timing can turn contracted backlog into financing stress if delivery slips.
GPU-cloud competition and hyperscaler self-build can pressure renewal economics and pricing.
